title: Terra — Sustainable Collection
description: A 12-piece womenswear collection inspired by circular fashion principles, raw earth tones, and zero-waste pattern cutting techniques.
modalDescription:
A 12-piece womenswear collection inspired by circular fashion principles, raw earth tones, and zero-waste pattern cutting techniques.

Each piece uses deadstock fabrics, natural dyes, and hand-finishing techniques. The collection debuted at Sasmira's 2025 graduation show.

title: The Entangled Souls
modalDescription:
An intimate collection exploring the tension between closeness and distance — garments built to be worn together, apart, or layered as a single entity.

Deconstructed seams, shared silhouettes, and hand-stitched connections form the vocabulary of this emotionally charged body of work.

title: Kerala Craft Project
modalDescription:
A study in architectural tailoring — exploring how garments can hold shape independently of the body. Inspired by Balenciaga archival pieces.

Constructed using bonded interlining, rigid organza, and hand-stitched boning, each garment stands as a wearable sculpture.

title: Stardust(Bunko-Junko)
description: Designed and created a sustainable fashion jacket as part of a Bunko Junko project, exploring eco-conscious design and responsible fashion practices.
modalDescription: Inspiration: Metallic Fluidity Fluidity of Formation: Metals are created in the chaotic, fluid environments of supernovae and stellar collisions. Using waste fabric swatches from the swatch book, we developed a sustainable yet glamorous jacket through patchwork techniques. The final garment, Stardust, reflects both creativity and conscious design.

title: Art of Layering
modalDescription:
A personal editorial project exploring how layering transforms a single garment into multiple looks. Shot in natural light with archival pieces from Mumbai's Chor Bazaar.

The 8-look editorial was featured on the institute's student showcase.

title: Bunko Junko
modalDescription:
A collaborative editorial for the institute annual magazine. Concept, styling, and creative direction by Saanika Bidwe. Theme: quiet luxury — understated garments, editorial restraint, the power of negative space.

Photographed at Worli Sea Face, Mumbai.

title: Draping Studies Vol. II
description: Experimental draping research exploring bias-cut techniques across natural fibres.
modalDescription:
The second volume of an ongoing draping research series, focusing on bias-cut techniques across natural fibres — linen, silk, and cotton voile.

Directly informed the structural vocabulary of the Terra collection, establishing a personal language of drape and form.

title: Noorani Collection
modalDescription:
A bridal and festive collection drawing from the luminous artistry of Mughal craft traditions — intricate zardozi embroidery, rich silk grounds, and sculpted silhouettes that command the room.

Noorani means 'radiant' — every look channels that quality of light.

title: Adirath Collection
modalDescription:
Adirath explores the intersection of traditional Indian weaving and minimalist contemporary silhouettes — handloom fabrics reimagined for the modern wardrobe.

Each piece is a dialogue between heritage craft and forward-thinking design.

title: Artisan Sketches
modalDescription:
A portfolio of fashion illustration studies capturing movement, drape, and proportion using ink, watercolour wash, and digital overlay.

Created during the Masaba Gupta Studio internship as visual reference material for the Festive 2024 collection briefing.
